FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 481
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/27/2026
House Bill 481 as introduced could delay collection certain fines, court costs, and fees, or
decrease the amount of such receipts, by an undetermined amount dependent on any such fees
that would be subordinate to victim restitution, as provided by this bill, that would not otherwise
be subordinated under current law.
